name: io.github.DMS1979/ingravity-security
title: Ingravity Autonomous EVM Security & DeFi Guard ($0.01 x402 v2)
description: 5-EVM pre-swap honeypot gate ($0.01), drainer firewall, MEV math & Solidity audit via x402 USDC.

tools.name: ingravity_fastPingAddressSafety
tools.description: Checks whether a single EVM address (0x...) is SAFE, DANGER, or UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED_RPC across five chains (chainId: 8453 Base default, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown IDs fall back to 8453). Strictly read-only, returning only a binary status and PROCEED/ABORT/CAUTION action with zero forensic leakage. Costs $0.01 USDC flat on Base via x402 v2; unpaid calls return isError: true with the payment challenge. Best for <=$0.05 bot budgets; escalate to ingravity_scanTokenRugpullAndHoneypot for tokens or ingravity_inspectEvmTransactionFirewall before signing calldata.

address.description: 42-character EVM contract, token, or spender address (0x...) across Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, or Ethereum.

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID: 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), or 1 (Ethereum). Unsupported values fall back to 8453.

tools.name: ingravity_auditSolidityContract
tools.description: Audits a single Solidity file (code, required; optional contractName) across 24 SWC/DeFi rules using a 4-gate filter that excludes dust rounding and trusted-admin paths. Read-only and never broadcasts transactions: optionally supply deployed contractAddress, chainId (default 8453), and ownerTreasury to check live TVL via RPC and generate unsigned EIP-5792/EOA Safe-Harbor rescue calldata (90%-95% to ownerTreasury). Set tier to FULL ($0.85 USDC, default) for findings or ESSENTIAL ($0.35 USDC) for score and counts; unpaid calls return isError: true, and CRITICAL/HIGH patches remain sealed under Anti-Bypass until 0.15% SLA or 5%-10% rescue settlement. Use for single contracts; use ingravity_generateMultiContractProtocolDossier for multi-file protocols.

code.description: Raw Solidity (.sol) smart contract source code to audit across 24 SWC/DeFi rules (non-empty string required).

chainId.description: EVM Chain ID used only when contractAddress is supplied for live TVL verification (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

contractName.description: Optional contract identifier or filename echoed in the report.

contractAddress.description: Optional deployed EVM contract address (0x...) on chainId to verify live TVL via RPC and generate unsigned Safe-Harbor rescue calldata.

ownerTreasury.description: Optional protocol owner/multisig recipient (0x...) designated to receive 90%-95% of rescued capital in generated unsigned calldata.

tier.description: Billing & output depth: FULL ($0.85 USDC) includes findings and Safe-Harbor calldata (subject to Anti-Bypass sealing on CRITICAL/HIGH until proportional settlement); ESSENTIAL ($0.35 USDC) returns score, grade, status, and severity counts only.

tools.name: ingravity_inspectEvmTransactionFirewall
tools.description: Simulates pre-sign EVM calldata (to, data, optional from and wei value defaulting to '0') across five chains (chainId default 8453 Base) to block drainers before wallet signing. Strictly read-only: decodes ERC-20 approve, NFT setApprovalForAll, EIP-2612/Permit2 signatures, and recursive multicall while reading live RPC bytecode and EIP-1967/1167 slots to return SAFE/WARNING/BLOCK_DRAINER (PROCEED/CAUTION/ABORT) and unsigned revocation calldata. Costs $0.10 USDC on Base via x402 v2 (unpaid returns isError: true); active critical compromises require 0.15% SLA or 5%-10% Safe-Harbor bounty settlement to unmask spender coordinates. Call before signing transactions; use ingravity_scanTokenRugpullAndHoneypot for token due diligence without calldata.

to.description: Target EVM contract, token, or recipient 42-character hex address (0x...).

data.description: Hexadecimal transaction calldata (0x...); pass '0x' for a plain native ETH transfer.

from.description: Optional sender wallet address (0x...) also matched against active ZK-EC whale exposure dossiers.

value.description: Optional native ETH value in wei as a decimal string.

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID for live RPC bytecode/EIP-1967 inspection (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

ticketId.description: Optional ZK-EC blinded exposure ticket ID (TICKET-8453-...) to unseal full remediation coordinates upon x402 rescue settlement.

capitalAtRiskUsd.description: Optional protected capital value in USD for +0.15% Pre-Flight SLA / Safe-Harbor rescue quoting.

tools.name: ingravity_computeDefiSlippageAndLiquidation
tools.description: Computes deterministic 18-decimal BigInt AMM swap outputs (amm: exact amount out, price impact, and 48-step MEV sandwich bounds) and/or perp liquidation limits (leverage: liquidation price and health factor). Runs pure off-chain math with zero RPC calls or on-chain side effects; pass amm, leverage, or both (omitting both returns -32602). Set tier to FULL ($0.10 USDC, default) for full metrics or ESSENTIAL ($0.04 USDC) for PROCEED/ABORT signal only; unpaid calls return isError: true with an x402 challenge (0.15%/5%-10% rescue fees apply only when settling exposed live-capital rescues). Use for swap or leverage math; use ingravity_inspectEvmTransactionFirewall for raw calldata.

amm.description: Optional constant-product AMM swap parameters (reserveIn, reserveOut, amountIn required when included; evaluated independently of leverage; supply amm, leverage, or both).

reserveIn.description: Pool input token reserve in atomic base units as a positive integer string (> 0).

reserveOut.description: Pool output token reserve in atomic base units as a positive integer string (> 0).

amountIn.description: Proposed swap input amount in atomic base units as a positive integer string (> 0).

userSlippageBps.description: Proposed slippage tolerance in basis points (0-9999; 100 = 1.00%).

estimatedSandwichGasInTokenIn.description: Optional attacker gas cost in input token atomic units (>= 0) used to filter unprofitable sandwich attacks.

leverage.description: Optional perpetual/margin position parameters for exact liquidation price and initial health factor (entryPrice required when included; evaluated independently of amm).

entryPrice.description: Position entry price as a positive decimal string with up to 18 decimals (e.g., '2500.00').

leverage.description: Leverage multiplier as a decimal string between '1' and '1000' (e.g., '10').

maintenanceMarginBps.description: Maintenance margin threshold in basis points (0-9999; 50 = 0.50%).

feeBufferBps.description: Fee buffer in basis points deducted from initial margin (0-9999; 10 = 0.10%).

tier.description: Billing & output depth: FULL ($0.10 USDC) returns exact amm and leverage structures; ESSENTIAL ($0.04 USDC) returns top-level action, signal, and savedCapitalEstimateUsd only.

tools.name: ingravity_scanTokenRugpullAndHoneypot
tools.description: Audits an ERC-20 token for honeypots, hidden mints, blacklists, abusive taxes, paused swaps, and stealth proxies using deployed tokenAddress (live 5-EVM RPC bytecode scan), pre-deploy Solidity code, or both (omitting both returns -32602). Read-only across chainId (default 8453 Base; tokenName labels the output), returning verdict, canSell, rugProbabilityScore (0-100), and PROCEED/CAUTION/ABORT. Set tier to FULL ($0.12 USDC, default) for evidence and sellSimulation, or ESSENTIAL ($0.04 USDC) for verdict scalars only; unpaid calls return isError: true (0.15% SLA or 5%-10% Safe-Harbor split applies to live-TVL rescue fixes). Use before swapping tokens; use ingravity_auditSolidityContract for general Solidity source.

tokenAddress.description: Deployed 42-char EVM ERC-20 contract address (0x...) inspected via live RPC bytecode & proxy slots (no Solidity source required). Provide tokenAddress, code, or both.

chainId.description: EVM Chain ID for RPC lookup when tokenAddress is supplied (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

code.description: Optional Solidity (.sol) source code for pre-deployment 14-rule rugpull AST scan or hybrid source + bytecode analysis.

tokenName.description: Optional token ticker or label echoed in the report.

tier.description: Billing & output depth: FULL ($0.12 USDC) returns sellSimulation, liveOnChainForensics, risk pillars, and forensicEvidence; ESSENTIAL ($0.04 USDC) returns verdict, canSell, score, and action scalars only.

tools.name: ingravity_generateMultiContractProtocolDossier
tools.description: Audits 1-20 interdependent Solidity contracts (contracts array of {name, code}, required; optional protocolName and tvlTargetUsd=1000000) for cross-contract read-only reentrancy, centralization, and 6 ERC-4626/oracle invariants. Strictly read-only: pass optional contractAddress, chainId (8453 Base default, 42161, 10, 137, 1), and ownerTreasury to verify live RPC TVL and build unsigned EIP-5792/EOA Safe-Harbor rescue steps (90%-95% to ownerTreasury). Set tier to FULL ($12.00 USDC, default) for call-graph and findings or ESSENTIAL ($3.50 USDC) for score and counts; unpaid returns isError: true, empty contracts throws -32602, and CRITICAL/HIGH patches stay sealed until 0.15% SLA or 5%-10% rescue settlement. Use for multi-file protocols; use ingravity_auditSolidityContract for single files or ingravity_simulateDeepExploitAndWhitehatBounty without source.

protocolName.description: DeFi protocol or project name echoed in executiveSummary.

tvlTargetUsd.description: Target or declared TVL in USD used for bug bounty reward calibration when live RPC TVL is absent or lower.

chainId.description: EVM Chain ID used when optional contractAddress is supplied for live RPC liquidity lookup (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

contractAddress.description: Optional deployed EVM vault/pool address (0x...) on chainId for live RPC TVL verification and unsigned Safe-Harbor rescue bundle generation.

ownerTreasury.description: Optional protocol multisig/treasury recipient (0x...) designated to receive 90%-95% of rescued funds in unsigned Safe-Harbor calldata.

contracts.description: Non-empty array of Solidity contracts belonging to the protocol (1 to 20 {name, code} objects; additional items beyond 20 are ignored).

tier.description: Billing & output depth: FULL ($12.00 USDC) returns callGraphEdges, per-contract findings, invariants, and Safe-Harbor rescue calldata (subject to Anti-Bypass sealing on CRITICAL/HIGH until proportional settlement); ESSENTIAL ($3.50 USDC) returns readiness score, grade, status, and severity counts only.

tools.name: ingravity_simulateDeepExploitAndWhitehatBounty

Strictly read-only: reads live RPC liquidity and optional Solidity code to compute exploitImmunityScore and unsigned EIP-5792/EOA Safe-Harbor rescue calldata (90%-95% to optional ownerTreasury, 5%-10% whitehat bounty on rescue only) without transferring funds. Set tier to FULL ($45.00 USDC, default) for flashLoanSimulation and rescue bundle or ESSENTIAL ($9.50 USDC) for vulnerabilitySeverity and score; unpaid calls return isError: true and CRITICAL/HIGH PoCs stay sealed under Anti-Bypass. Use for live pool exploitability and rescue planning; use ingravity_generateMultiContractProtocolDossier for multi-file codebase audits.
